sources.scope: 20 µF #29A/#29B filters, 500 Ω #28 field winding, 40/80 Ω #30 tap and #32 shunt, rectifier anode/cathode routing.
35Z3 nominal heater 35 V / 0.15 A; tube voltage-drop reference 18 V at 200 mA DC. This one point does not validate a full I–V curve.
Nominal hot heater resistance sum 692.6667 Ω from rated V/I; cold heaters and warm-up not represented.
Separate RCA reference model checked against the average forward curve; nominal 35 V heater, 5–40 V forward drop.

rectifier_approximation.provenance: Legacy GE reference retained for reproducibility. A separately identified RCA curve model is selectable; neither identifies the installed physical tube. See rectifier_models.

assumption_policy: Field inductance, lamp hot resistance, 60 Hz mains and resistive stand-in receiver loads are explicit test inputs, not Philco measurements. The source-derived topology is retained while these inputs vary. Do not fit to 95/110 V factory labels with undocumented measurement conditions.
exclusions: Full receiver tube currents, output transformer and screen-feed load (represented by explicit load ports)
Cold-heater warm-up and nonlinear lamp I–V
Calibrated 35Z3 curve, reverse leakage and breakdown
Field inductance measurement, winding parasitics, capacitor ESR and dielectric absorption
#31 is across the externally imposed ideal line; its source-current contribution is excluded from reported heater/rectifier currents
AC/DC switch physical lugs and metal-chassis bond; return is B− only

numerical_contract.integrator: Implicit backward Euler; coupled reservoir, smoothing capacitor and field-inductor states; monotonic diode solve
numerical_contract.load_port_contract: Independent load_laws callbacks return {current_a, conductance_s}; alternatively coupled_load_law receives {reservoir_v, filtered_v}, time and returns currents_a:[Irect,Ifilt], jacobian_s:[[dIrect/dVrect,dIrect/dVfilt],[dIfilt/dVrect,dIfilt/dVfilt]]. This permits actual multi-electrode receiver-stage coupling. Default ports are declared test resistors.
numerical_contract.spice_reference: Independent ngspice B-source rectifier, heater/dropper/lamp network and R-L-C filter with adaptive Gear integration; integrates startup and reports the same final six-cycle window.
